title: 第11章 天命大熔炉新手大礼包第12章 一家全是大佬就我一个异类
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
此话一出，现场气氛顿时凝沉下来。
叶沉雁一改哀伤的情绪，眼底泛涌着冰冷的杀机。
对于一个母亲而言，伤害她的儿女，无异于取她性命。
无论那人是谁，都必须付出沉重的代价。
陈稳也在第一时间听出陈红眠所指。
这三男一女，无非就是楚幼微，罗浩和楚北穹了。
刚好，他也想亲手弄死这四个狗东西。
念及此，陈稳才冷声道，“我知道该怎么做了。”
“记住了，我们陈族可以不惹事，但没人能骑到我们头上。”
“你想做什么，大可去做便是了，一切都有我们给你兜着。”
说到这，陈红眠的声音渐渐冷冽起来，“哪怕最后你与整方天地对抗，背后也一定会站着我们四个人。”
“死不离，战不休，大不了一起葬在这万古天穹之下。”
陈霸道，叶沉雁和陈无敌皆是一脸的郑重，周身气势肃然，无所畏惧。
陈稳直愣愣地看着四人许久，才重重地点头，“我知道了。”
也许在此之前，他是被叶沉雁的真情感动。
那现在的他，就真真的将自己当成这个家庭的一份子了。
这些人比他想象中更爱自己啊。
“行了行了，我们还是先出去吧，让小稳调整一下情绪。”
陈霸道再次开口道。
这次叶沉雁等人没有再犹豫，相继出了房间，并把门关上。

叶沉雁脸色突然沉了下来，“我需要知道这十六年来，小稳所经历的一切。”
“我这就去办。”陈无敌立时应道。
“尽可详尽，我不想错过他任何的一点成长。”叶沉雁再次开口道。
“好。”陈无敌应了一声，便往外走了出去。
而与此同时。
陈稳调整了情绪后，才道：“前辈，你还在吗？”
“有事？”女声响起。
“敢问前辈尊姓大名？”陈稳试探问道。
“仙红芍。”女声淡淡道。
“好名字啊，果然还得是前辈。”陈稳适时拍了一下子马屁。
“呵呵，你这是有所求吧，有什么直接说吧。”仙红芍淡淡道。
这什么鬼。
我这拍马屁的功夫明明已经炉火纯青了，为啥在这不管用？
这人肯定是不通人类情绪，并不是我的问题。
陈稳自我攻略了一番，才又笑道，“是这样的，你是不是该跟我说一下天命大熔炉和混沌序列体的作用？”
“对了还有，别人好像都有新手礼包的，我们这比金手指更强的存在，应该也得有吧。”
仙红芍淡淡道：“混沌序列体诸天最古老的体质，没有之一。”
“除此之外，它还有突破桎梏的潜力，蜕变成一种全新的体传。”
“那强在哪里？”陈稳不由问道。
“强在它拥有九道序列枷锁，每解锁一道就能获得一种绝对天赋。”

“绝对火种强不强？而你后续解锁的每一种绝对天赋都不比它差。”
“除了这实质的好处外，这体质隐藏的优点才是最强大的。”
“在同等程度开发的情况下，它可以镇压一切体质。”
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere at the scene suddenly became tense.
Ye Chenyan changed his sad mood, and there was cold murderous intent in his eyes.
For a mother, harming her children is tantamount to taking her life.
Whoever that person is will have to pay a heavy price.
Chen Wen also immediately heard what Chen Hongmian was referring to.
These three men and one woman are nothing more than Chu Youwei, Luo Hao and Chu Beiqiong.
It just so happened that he also wanted to kill these four bitches with his own hands.
Thinking of this, Chen Wencai said coldly, "I know what to do."
"Remember, we Chen clan can avoid causing trouble, but no one can get on top of us."
"Whatever you want to do, you can just do it. We will take care of everything for you."
Speaking of this, Chen Hongmian's voice gradually became colder, "Even if you confront the whole world in the end, there will definitely be four of us standing behind you."
"We will never leave each other until we die, and we will never stop fighting. At worst, we will be buried together under the eternal sky."
Chen Badao, Ye Chenyan and Chen Wudi all had solemn expressions on their faces, with a solemn and fearless aura around them.
Chen Wen stared at the four of them blankly for a long time before nodding heavily, "I understand."
Maybe before that, he was moved by Ye Chenyan's true feelings.
Now he really regards himself as a member of this family.
These people love him more than he imagined.
"Okay, okay, let's go out first and let Xiaowen adjust his mood."
Chen Badao spoke again.
This time, Ye Chenyan and others did not hesitate anymore, and left the room one after another and closed the door.
Ye Chenyan's face suddenly darkened, "I need to know everything that Xiaowen has experienced in the past sixteen years."
"I'll do it right away." Chen Wudi responded immediately.
"As detailed as possible, I don't want to miss any of his growth." Ye Chenyan said again.
"Okay." Chen Wudi responded and walked out.
And at the same time.
After Chen Wen adjusted his emotions, he said: "Senior, are you still there?"
"Is something wrong?" a female voice sounded.
"Dare you ask me your senior's name?" Chen Wen asked tentatively.
"Fairy red peony root." The female voice said calmly.
"What a good name. Sure enough, it has to be a senior." Chen Wen flattered him at the right time.
"Haha, you must be asking for something. If you have anything, just say it directly." Xian Hongshao said calmly.
What the hell is this.
I'm obviously very good at flattery, so why doesn't it work here?
This guy definitely doesn't understand human emotions, and it's not my problem.
Chen Wen thought about it for a while before he smiled again and said, "That's right. Should you tell me about the functions of the Destiny Furnace and the Chaos Sequence?"
"By the way, others seem to have gift packages for beginners. We, being stronger than Goldfinger, should also have one."
Xian Hongshao said calmly: "The Chaos Sequence Body has the oldest constitution in the world."
"In addition, it also has the potential to break through the shackles and transform into a brand new physical transmission."
"Where is the strength?" Chen Wen couldn't help but ask.
"The strength is that it has nine sequence shackles. Each time you unlock one, you can gain an absolute talent."
"Is the absolute fire strong? And every absolute talent you unlock later is no worse than it."
"Aside from the substantial benefits, the hidden advantages of this physique are the most powerful."
"When developed to the same extent, it can suppress all physiques."
